summary: Defines how to use the Lempel-Ziv-Stac (LZS) compression algorithm inside the TLS protocol. TLS lets two sides negotiate lossless compression, but its only standard method at the time was no compression at all.

eli5.summary: Before sending a suitcase through a secure tunnel, you squeeze the clothes down so they take less room. This memo describes one way to squeeze them.

questions: how to compress data in tls
